correctness.rationale: For exact-Pareto \(T\) with \(\alpha>2\), the complete-cycle reward \(R=2DT^2J\) has \(\mathbb ER=D\mathbb ET^2\) and \(\mathbb ER^2=(7/3)D^2\mathbb ET^4\). The centered reward \(Y=R-\mu T\) has positive tail index \(\beta=\alpha/2\) with coefficient \(c=\mathbb E(2DJ)^\beta\) and negligible negative tail, proving a stable weak limit when \(2<\alpha<4\). At \(\alpha=4\), the truncated variance is asymptotic to \(2c_4\log z\) with \(c_4=7D^2/3\), giving limiting Gaussian variance \(c_4/m=7D^2/4\); \(\alpha>4\) gives the finite-variance Gaussian CLT. Tightness of the terminal age and incomplete reward, plus i.i.d. functional random-index convergence, justify the full occupation integral. The standalone checker passed 36 tests after extraction from the package. Finite checks are not substituted for the analytic limits.

value.rationale: Quadratic trajectory exposure is an intrinsic displacement-energy observable in resetting diffusion. Its deterministic mean exists for every \(\alpha>2\), but Gaussian root-time sampling uncertainty holds only for \(\alpha>4\); the exact logarithmic and spectrally positive stable regimes exhibit a sharp failure of conventional Gaussian error bars. The threshold follows structurally from Brownian cycle reward scaling as \(T^2\), rather than an arbitrary finite computation.
